maria (partnerships): ACME marketplace flagged our runtime images: kernel module signatures don't pass their registry policy. They asked for either pinned driver+CUDA combos with signed kernel blobs or a guaranteed compat matrix. Can we propose a quick path? :thinking:

alex (eng-runtime): We can provide a small set of immutable, signed images + an auto-generated compat CSV. Prefer certified tags over wide pinning to keep rollback flexibility.

todd (platform): Agree. We'll enforce tag immutability and include signature fingerprints and SHA256 of signed blobs in the manifest. Need a 48h canary before partner pull.

jia (partner-eng): ACME also wants HSM/KMS-backed signatures and an embargoed announcement timeline once certification completes. They'll validate using their KMS.

ben (sre): Note: CI found a perf regression on CUDA 12.3 for A100 after recent runtime changes. If we pick driver 525 + CUDA12.2 for ACME that avoids it, but we must run compatibility tests.

alex (eng-runtime): Plan: CI job does build -> sign -> quick compat checks (launch + perf sample + infer smoke) -> publish image + compat CSV. Snippet: `./ci/sign-kmod --kmod out/driver-525.ko --kms /env/kms-acme && ./ci/publish --image rwinf/acme:525-signed --manifest compat/acme-525.csv`

maria (partnerships): Timeline: ACME requested next-week certification window. Owners: alex -> signing-service PR; todd -> publish job & tag freeze; jia -> partner CSV + manifest endpoint; ben -> rollback playbook + canary alert. Can we hit it?

alex (eng-runtime): I can do a minimal signing-service MVP in ~48h.

todd (platform): Publish job + tag freeze by EOD tomorrow if prioritized.

jia (partner-eng): I'll prepare CSV skeleton and the public manifest endpoint today.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: infra/canary/acme-image-20260320 starting 2026-03-20T02:00Z. Notifying @partners @sre.

maria (partnerships): Great. I'll update ACME with a provisional schedule and legal/embargo notes. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
